name: bkk-temple-roofs
description: Thai temple halls and chedis from the OpenStreetMap detail layer, re-massed by type: walls on the real footprint, a tiered gable on its oriented rectangle, ridge on the long axis; chedis as a bell stack. The overall height is the detail layer's own, with its source copied onto every part. The form is a documented TYPE, not a survey of the building.
